text:
emma: Customer reports tool/function-call failures when passing a JSON string inside a string arg. They see schema validation errors and occasional timeouts.

emma: sample error from logs:
```
ERROR: schema_validation: unexpected type: string for field "items" (expected array)
RequestID: req_0a1b2c
``` 

miguel: can you paste the original request payload + headers (sanitized)?

emma: here — payload that failed:
```json
{"tool":"price_lookup","args":"{ 'items': 'sku123' }","content_type":"application/json"}
```
(They were double-stringifying the args; single quotes + stringified JSON)

sophia: ah — looks like our function-calling schema validator treats the `args` field as already-parsed JSON. When clients double-stringify or use single quotes we throw a 422. CI golden test for `price_lookup` started failing after the validator tighten change in Feb — possible regression.

ci-bot: CI: https://ci.internal/runs/4821 toolcall-schema-suite failed on test `price_lookup_malformed_args` (build #4821)

emma: repro steps I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"lookup","tool":"price_lookup","args":"{ 'items': 'sku123' }"}'
```
Response: 422 + `schema_validation` or sometimes 504 after timeout when parser retries.

miguel: root cause hypothesis: we added strict schema parsing that no longer attempts quick JSON.parse on string-typed args. Two problems: (1) clients that double-stringify break, (2) our retry path sometimes triggers a blocking parse leading to timeouts under load.

miguel: proposed immediate fix: lenient pre-parse hook — if `args` is string and Content-Type is application/json, attempt safe JSON.parse (replace single quotes -> double, sanitize), otherwise return explicit 422 with guidance. Add a small timeout so parser can't block the request loop.

sophia: I'll add a regression test to the evals/golden suite: `price_lookup_malformed_args` covering single-quoted and double-stringified args, and run against the staging validator. Also add a CI check so this test is required for merges to `eng-runtime`.

emma: customer says this is blocking their integration; marking P1. Any chance for a hotfix?

miguel: I'll open a PR today and cut a hotfix to staging. Assigning to @sophia for tests and @emma for rollout comms. Will link PR here when ready.

miguel: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/912 (draft)

sophia: running the new test locally now; failing as expected. After the parser change tests pass. Planning a canary on dedicated for 2 hours.

emma: thx. I'll update the customer and request logs/timestamps for verification after the canary.

ci-bot: Note: adding new golden test will increase suite time by ~12s.
